creator.name: Jesse
creator.expertise: Computer technical skills, self-taught developer with hands-on experience building Flutter mobile apps, Python ML pipelines, and FastAPI backends
creator.background: Autodidact who built AviQuest (a bird identification app with 1,049 species, TFLite visual ML, BirdNET audio ID, and a full gamification system) from scratch. Now expanding the concept to dogs as part of a larger Shazanimal vision — 'Shazam for every living creature.' Has deep experience shipping on-device ML, Flutter UI, and Python training pipelines.

purpose.whoYouHelp: Dog owners, dog enthusiasts, and families who love dogs — anyone who encounters dogs and wants to identify breeds, connect with other dog people, track their pets, and learn about these amazing creatures through play
purpose.problemYouSolve: Dog breed identification apps are one-trick ponies with poor accuracy and no social layer. You ID a breed and that's it — no reason to come back, no community, no progression. Meanwhile, dog owners have no fun, engaging way to connect with other owners, track their pets' stats, or find lost dogs in their neighborhood.
purpose.desiredTransformation: Users go from passively liking dogs to actively exploring the dog world. They become confident breed identifiers, build collections that reward curiosity, connect with local dog owners, and turn every walk into a discovery adventure. Clueless becomes expert, passive becomes engaged, solo becomes connected.
purpose.whyYou: Dog lover who can code and saw nothing good exists in this space. Already solved the hard ML problems with AviQuest for birds — proven ability to ship a species-ID app that actually works on-device. DogQuest is part of the bigger Shazanimal vision, and the technical foundation is already battle-tested.

product.name: DogQuest
product.oneLiner: Identify, collect, and connect — the dog lover's companion powered by AI.
product.howItWorks: Point your camera at any dog and DogQuest instantly identifies the breed using on-device ML. Each new breed goes into your kennel collection with fun facts, rarity tier, and stats. Earn XP through combos, streaks, and daily challenges. Build your Dog Passport, form a Pack with family, make dog friendships, find lost dogs on the neighborhood map, and connect with breed communities through the social feed.
keyCapabilities: AI-powered dog breed identification using on-device TFLite ML (294 breeds)
Gamified collection system with XP, combos, streaks, mastery, rarity tiers, daily challenges, and achievements
Social layer with dog profiles, activity feed, dogs nearby, breed communities, and playdate matching
Lost dog alerts and neighborhood map with real-time tracking
Dog Passport cards, Pack (family co-ownership), and dog friendships
product.marketDifferentiation: Three layers no competitor has together: (1) Gamification depth — combos, streaks, mastery, rarity tiers, daily challenges, flash challenges, and mystery rewards layered on breed ID. Nobody else treats breed discovery as a collection game. (2) Social + local — neighborhood map, lost dog alerts, playdates, breed communities. It's not just ID, it's a dog lifestyle app. (3) Part of Shazanimal — DogQuest is one module in the 'Shazam for every creature' platform, with proven bird identification already shipping.
product.magicMoment: Point your camera at a dog, get the breed identified instantly with fun facts and a rarity tier. Then discover another DogQuest user nearby and see their collection. The combination of 'whoa it actually works' and 'there are other people doing this' is the hook.

audience.primaryUser: Dog owner, age 25-45, walks their dog regularly, curious about other breeds they encounter at parks and on walks, wants to connect with the local dog community, uses their phone as their primary device
secondaryUsers: Dog enthusiasts aged 18-35 who don't necessarily own a dog but love them — follow dog accounts on social media, visit shelters, want to learn breeds
Families with kids (parents 30-45) who use the app together as an outdoor educational activity, turning walks into treasure hunts
audience.currentAlternatives: Dog Scanner (ad-heavy, inaccurate, no gamification), Google Lens (vague breed results, no collection or community), breed-specific apps (single breed, no broad identification), generic pet apps (not focused on breed identification or discovery)
audience.frustrations: Existing apps are one-trick ponies — they ID the breed and that's it, no reason to come back. Accuracy is mediocre across the board. There's zero social layer — no way to connect with other dog people, no community, no local features. And everything feels clinical and boring, not fun and game-like.

business.initialGoal: Launch on Google Play Store and acquire 500+ users within 90 days while simultaneously using DogQuest as the live POC to raise $250-500K pre-seed funding for the broader Shazanimal platform
business.sixMonthVision: 5,000+ active users with strong retention metrics (D7 > 30%, D30 > 15%), pre-seed funding secured, iOS version in development, and the Shazanimal core abstraction underway to support plants as the next creature module
business.constraints: Solo founder with no budget. Everything must be buildable and operable alone. No team, no funding yet. Speed matters — need to be investor-ready and on the Play Store within 90 days.
business.goToMarket: Reddit dog communities (r/dogs 5M+, r/dogpictures 4M+, r/IDmydog 200K+ — literally the use case), TikTok and Instagram Reels with short-form 'what breed is that?' videos filmed at dog parks showing the app working live, and Facebook dog breed groups. Content is inherently shareable — breed ID results make great social posts.

feeling.brandPersonality: Adventurous and energetic — like a hiking buddy with a dog. 'Let's go discover!' energy. Enthusiastic but not annoying. Celebrates wins, encourages exploration, keeps things moving. Treats users as smart and capable.
feeling.visualMood: Warm earthy base with energetic accents. Browns (#4A2F1A), ambers, and forest greens as the foundation — grounded, organic, dog-world. Gold/amber accents for achievements and XP, forest green for exploration and map features, warm red for alerts and lost dogs. Bouncy animations and satisfying haptics on discoveries, but grounded typography and layout. Think National Geographic meets Duolingo — the outdoors, but gamified.
feeling.toneOfVoice: Direct, warm, and action-oriented. Short sentences. Celebrates discoveries without being cheesy. Example discovery: 'Golden Retriever — Common breed. You've found 3 of 294!' Example achievement: 'Snow Pack complete! You found all 8 cold-weather breeds.' Example empty state: 'Your kennel is empty. Time to explore!' Never uses baby talk or over-explains.
feeling.antiPatterns: Never clinical or boring — no Wikipedia walls of text, no sterile UI. This is a game, not a database. Never ad-heavy or spammy — ads exist but never interrupt the core experience, no dark patterns, no paywalls on basic features. Never childish — playful does not mean juvenile, no baby talk, no cartoon dogs, respect the user's intelligence.

frontend.rationale: Already built — entire app exists in Flutter/Dart with 34 screens, 50+ services, Riverpod state management, go_router navigation. Cross-platform capability for future iOS expansion.

backend.rationale: Real-time subscriptions for social feed and dogs nearby, built-in auth (OAuth, email, anonymous), PostgreSQL database, file storage for dog photos, official supabase_flutter package, generous free tier (50K MAU). Replaces the need to build auth, real-time, and storage from scratch.

database.rationale: Hive provides fast local-first storage for offline operation (sightings, player stats, kennel). Supabase PostgreSQL handles shared state (social feed, lost dog reports, user profiles, community data). Hybrid approach keeps the app responsive while enabling social features.

auth.rationale: Included with Supabase backend, supports email/password, OAuth providers, and anonymous auth. Official Flutter SDK. Replaces the current local-only Hive-based auth.

payments.rationale: Free + ads revenue model. Google AdMob integrates natively with Flutter via google_mobile_ads package. Banner and interstitial ads with frequency caps to avoid disrupting the core experience.
